message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to make a traditional lasagna:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1–1½ lb (450–680 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 cloves |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1–2 Tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp |
| | Fresh basil leaves (optional) | ¼ cup, torn |
| | Sugar (optional, to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | Beef broth or water | ½ cup |
| | Bay leaf | 1 |
| **Ricotta Layer** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg | 1 (helps bind) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| **Mozzarella Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, wilted) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Caramelized onions | ½ cup |
| | Pesto (for layering) | ¼ cup |
| **Topping** | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Fresh basil leaves | ¼ cup |

### Quick Tips
- **No‑boil sheets** save time; just add a bit more water to the sauce.
- For a richer flavor, brown the meat before adding tomatoes.
- If you’re using fresh spinach, wilt it first to reduce moisture.
- Let the lasagna rest 10–15 min after baking before slicing.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
